name: Diamond Harbour

queries.query: Diamond Harbour West Bengal official cadastral parcel map land records GIS map
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of West Bengal Banglarbhumi land-record portal, the Urban Development and Municipal Affairs Know Your Property procedure, the West Bengal state GIS portal, and Diamond Harbour Municipality map context. Banglarbhumi advertises RS-LR plot information, plot-map and mouza-map services, but citizen services require login.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: West Bengal Land and Land Reforms and Refugee Relief and Rehabilitation Department, through the official Banglarbhumi portal; Diamond Harbour Municipality is local urban-government context, but no municipality-operated cadastral vector service was evidenced.
officialSourceAssessment.stateService: Banglarbhumi advertises RS-LR Plot Information, Plot Map Request, Mouza Map Request and Mouza Map Availability Details. UDMA says its Know Your Property data is replicated from Land and Land Reforms and Registration and Stamp Revenue databases.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: First-party West Bengal land-record registry/service context is evidenced; this does not establish anonymous parcel geometry access or citywide coverage.
